culture_principles.name: Structured client problem solving
culture_principles.description: McKinsey-style strength starts with objective clarification, tailored issue trees, hypotheses, data requests, quantitative reasoning, synthesis, and a practical recommendation.

culture_principles.name: Personal impact and leadership stories
culture_principles.description: The PEI-style lens requires deep evidence of leadership, personal impact, conflict, challenge, and drive, not generic fit answers.

culture_principles.name: Client service with ethical judgment
culture_principles.description: Strong answers should improve client or organizational outcomes while preserving integrity, dissent, and duty to speak up.

culture_principles.name: Top-down communication
culture_principles.description: Consulting answers should lead with the answer, then support it with structured reasoning, numbers, caveats, and next steps.

hiring_signals.signal: Builds a structured case approach with hypotheses, prioritized analysis, quantitative logic, and a clear recommendation.
Uses PEI stories with specific personal action, stakes, conflict, leadership, and result.
Communicates top-down with concise recommendation, supporting logic, and risks.
Balances client impact with dissent, integrity, and willingness to speak up.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Unstructured case response with random analyses and no hypothesis or recommendation.
anti_signals.risk_reason: McKinsey interviews explicitly test problem-solving through client scenarios.

anti_signals.anti_signal: PEI story that is a resume summary rather than one deep personal-impact episode.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Candidate and official interview materials emphasize personal experience depth.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Client service interpreted as telling the client what they want to hear.
anti_signals.risk_reason: McKinsey values include obligation to dissent/speak up and professional conduct boundaries.

interview_patterns.pattern: Consulting roles commonly combine Solve, PEI/personal experience, and problem-solving/case interviews.
Case interviews should test issue trees, math, synthesis, recommendation, and client pragmatism.
Digital/technology consulting should combine business problem solving with technical/product feasibility and change adoption.

honest_limits: This is a public-source and private-distillation draft lens and does not represent an official McKinsey hiring standard.
Private materials authorized by the project owner are included only as distilled aggregate patterns, not raw article text or copied questions.
Interview format can vary by office, role, seniority, region, and recruiting channel.
This v0.1 lens has static validation cases but is not approved for production screening until live answer backtesting and reviewer approval are complete.
This v0.2 lens has structured evidence records and an evidence audit, but is still not approved for production screening.
Public source URLs and private-material provenance must be reviewed before v1.0 approval.
Manual case-book distillation notes are included only as aggregate training and scoring heuristics; raw book text, copied frameworks, and copyrighted examples must not be committed or surfaced.
